newsitem.title: UK: S&P rates Illinois Treasurers' Pool AAAm.
newsitem.headline: S&P rates Illinois Treasurers' Pool AAAm.

text.p: Standard & Poor's said on Wednesday it assigned its AAAm rating to the Illinois Public Treasurers' Investment Pool (IPTIP), citing the pool's superior capacity to maintain principal ($1.00 per share value) and limit exposure to loss.
The AAAm rating is S&P's highest rating assigned to stable net asset value pools, S&P said.

The investment pool, developed and implemented in 1975 by the Illinois General Assembly, is under the jurisdiction of State Treasurer Judy Baar Topinka. With $2.4 billion in assets, it is the fifth largest of the 20 stable net asset value local government investment pools that S&P rates.
"S&P noted that the pool's liquidity was extremely strong, with more than 70 percent of its investments in overnight securities," S&P said.
The rating also incorporates an analysis of the pool's management, investment guidelines, portfolio holdings, and market price exposure, S&P said.
